root_cause.text: The match_policy_in() function uses an incorrect index calculation (i - sp->len + 1) to map the reverse traversal of sec_path transforms to a forward index into the policy array, producing negative or out-of-bounds indices in strict mode that cause array access beyond allocated memory.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the formula from `pos = strict ? i - sp->len + 1 : 0;` to `pos = strict ? sp->len - i - 1 : 0;`, correcting the mapping so that transforms are consumed in forward order. The commit description explains that strict policy matching needs to consume info->pol[] in the same forward order as the rule layout.
